subject: Re: Risk-explanation kickoff: explaining why risk went up, not just that it did
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing and dependencies.

People: Vera 60% on the observation-sequence model and explanation weights, Bilal 70% on ingestion and the TFRecord/SequenceExample pipeline (batch sizes 64 train / 128 eval per the reference input_fn setup carry over fine), Gustavo 40% on eval tooling and the clinical-review packet.

Platform dependencies: our reference and partner-shaped data flows through Corpus. On timing - Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-07-24, which gives us two clear weeks after window close to port our SequenceExample ingestion to the v2 path - so no migration work lands inside this project's schedule. I've planned Bilal's quarter on that basis.

Compute: light. Training the observation sequence model is a single-node job; a dozen Titan A100 slots at peak for the hyperparameter passes.

Privacy: filed Mar 26 with Kofi, so the 2-3 week SLA has sign-off landing around mid-April, well before any partner data touches us.

Jelena
